trap-nonspeakable.notes: THREE FLAGS for the report, all internal contradictions rather than traps. (1) E_0^(cal) = Q_beta(n)/|Delta(net)| is labelled '(CAL-3 cross-check via CODATA)' while the same block states four times that Q_beta is the CAL-2 proxy - it is a CAL-2 cross-check. (2) The Wedderburn calibration map here assigns alt (1^3) -> CAL-2 -> q_0 and sym (3) -> CAL-3 -> m_pi; the sibling rem:three-parameters-wedderburn-context in this same chapter assigns sym (3) -> m_mu/m_e -> q_0 and alt (1^3) -> Q_beta. The sym and alt assignments are swapped between the two blocks. (3) 'particle content is topological (from chi(A) = -6)' cites an Euler characteristic that is neither defined nor cross-referenced here.
